name: Santa María del Páramo (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, red and blue with a white central pale charged with the crowned municipal arms of Santa María del Páramo (the monogram of Mary on blue above a tower between trees).
history: The flag of Santa María del Páramo was designed in 2009 by Laureano M. Rubio Pérez and approved by the municipal council on 15 July 2009; it was officially published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 15 June 2010. The flag is rectangular of 2:3 and at its centre has a white vertical band of 1/3 of the width of the flag charged with the municipal arms.
